intro: StorageCafe, StorageUnitCosts, and Storage Stats do not publish an East Honolulu market average. The rates below are the advertised web rates at one facility in the East Honolulu / Hawaii Kai area: Extra Space Storage at 6800 Kalanianaole Hwy, Honolulu, HI 96825, within a mile of Hawaii Kai. They are climate-controlled elevator-access web rates checked October 29, 2026, not an average of several facilities. A first-floor 10x10 at the same building was listed at a $560 web rate. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above the web rate used here.
data_asof: Oct 29, 2026 (one Extra Space facility web rate; climate-controlled elevator access). No StorageCafe East Honolulu average; no StorageUnitCosts city page; no Storage Stats market page.

units.notes: Extra Space web rate for a climate-controlled elevator-access 5x5, $177. A first-floor climate-controlled 5x5 locker was listed at a $124 web rate. One facility, not a city average.
Extra Space web rate for a climate-controlled elevator-access 5x10, $240. A first-floor 5x10 was also listed at a $240 web rate. No reliable separate promo floor (gap). One facility.

Extra Space web rate for a climate-controlled elevator-access 10x10, $348, at 6800 Kalanianaole Hwy (96825). The first-floor climate-controlled 10x10 web rate was $560. Not a multi-facility average. Honolulu citywide StorageCafe averages were not substituted.
Extra Space web rate for a climate-controlled elevator-access 10x15, $533. The first-floor web rate was $560. One facility.
Extra Space web rate for a climate-controlled elevator-access 10x20 (listed as 20x10), $899. One facility.

local_tips: These figures are one building's web rates, checked October 29, 2026. East Honolulu does not have its own StorageCafe statistics page, so nothing here is a citywide average.
The facility is by Kalanianaole Hwy and Keahole St, within about a mile of Hawaii Kai Towne Center.
Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts' fee notes, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if this building charges more.
